questions.stem: Two radioactive elements $A$ and $B$ initially have same number of atoms. The half life of $A$ is same as the average life of $B$. If $\lambda_A$ and $\lambda_B$ are decay constants of $A$ and $B$ respectively, then choose the correct relation from the given options.
questions.solution: The half-life of A is $\ln2/\lambda_A$, and the mean life of B is $1/\lambda_B$. Equating them gives $\lambda_A=\lambda_B\ln2$.
